subject: PHYSICS
description: Disciplinary ontology, representations, and validation invariants for Grade 9-11 Physics (CBSE, JEE Main, JEE Advanced).

FOUNDATION.name: CBSE_BOARD
FOUNDATION.target: Conceptual clarity, standard 1D/2D kinematics, Newton's laws, conservation, direct formula applications, board definitions.

STANDARD.name: JEE_MAINS
STANDARD.target: Multi-step analytical mechanics, coordinate frame transformations, relative velocity in 2D, projectile on inclined plane, friction transitions, work-energy theorem.

RESEARCH.name: JEE_ADVANCED_OLYMPIAD
RESEARCH.target: Non-inertial reference frames and fictitious forces, variable mass systems, constrained motion, continuous distributions, extreme limiting-case falsifications, coupled differential equations.

epistemological_rules: Distinguish observer-dependent kinematic quantities (displacement, velocity) from frame-invariant physical laws.
Enforce dimensional homogeneity: terms added or equated must have identical dimensional powers [M^a L^b T^c I^d].
Every kinematic model must explicitly declare its inertial or non-inertial reference frame.
Non-inertial models must explicitly include pseudo-forces (-m*a_frame) with explicit observer declaration.
Limiting cases (e.g. mass m2 >> m1, velocity v -> 0, angle theta -> 0 or 90 deg) must be mathematically falsified.
